subject: Error in getExportSaveName(crv$RPART) : attempt to apply non-function

messages.subject: Error in getExportSaveName(crv$RPART) : attempt to apply non-function
parts:
Using the Export button on the Rattle page results in the following error message on the R console:
Error in getExportSaveName(crv$RPART) : attempt to apply non-function

This occurs on both Windows 7 and Mac OSX with latest R and Rattle installed.
